description:
Images produced by known space agencies appear grouped under the 'Wikimedia Commons contributors' section on /credits instead of under their own agency's section

Expected: Every image-provenance entry whose agency field names a known space agency resolves to that agency's source-logos bucket — not to wikimedia-commons — via the validator mirror that duplicates the production routing logic

Acceptance criteria:
- The validator mirror's agencyToSourceId('CMSA') must return a non-null value (matching the production code that already maps CMSA → cnsa) [repo-data: scripts/validate-credits-bundling.ts:71-89 (stale agencyToSourceId) vs src/lib/credits-grouping.ts:185-186 (production copy with `if (a.includes('cmsa')) return 'cnsa'`)]
- The validator mirror's agencyToSourceId('USAF') must return a non-null value (matching production, which maps USAF → us-space-force via `a.includes('usaf')`) [repo-data: scripts/validate-credits-bundling.ts:71-89 misses `a.includes('usaf')` and `a.includes('air force')` present in src/lib/credits-grouping.ts:210-215]
- The validator mirror's agencyToSourceId('SpaceIL') must return a non-null value (matching production, which maps SpaceIL → spaceil) [repo-data: scripts/validate-credits-bundling.ts:71-89 misses `a.includes('spaceil')` present in src/lib/credits-grouping.ts:192]
- Running validate-credits-bundling.ts against static/data/image-provenance.json must report 0 CMSA entries routing to wikimedia-commons under its computation [code-invariant: Production code already routes 0/135 CMSA entries to wikimedia-commons; the validator mirror still routes 121/135 (measured above), proving the drift is in the mirror alone]
- Running validate-credits-bundling.ts must report 0 USAF and 0 SpaceIL entries routing to wikimedia-commons [code-invariant: Production routes 0/20 USAF + 0/11 SpaceIL to wikimedia-commons; validator mirror still routes 20/20 USAF + 9/11 SpaceIL]

Domain facts:
- The validator script scripts/validate-credits-bundling.ts runs as part of npm run validate-data (via scripts/validate-data-runner.ts), which is chained into npm run build and npm run preflight. Its agencyToSourceId is a duplicated mirror explicitly noted as manually maintained.
- The validator exits 0 by default even with stale routing (no --fail-on-split), but the ftp test validates against the validator's computation path, not just the production code.
- The production fix (commit aaaab7f6e) added 3 patterns not present in the validator: CMSA→cnsa, SpaceIL/Space IL→spaceil, USAF/air force→us-space-force, CSA→csa.

Target: scripts/validate-credits-bundling.ts — agencyToSourceId (lines 71-89)
Do NOT change src/lib/credits-grouping.ts (production routing IS correct after commit aaaab7f6e; the validator mirror is a second, stale copy that needs the identical change) — it is not the owner of this symptom.
